_comment: Generated reference entries that are merged but not in a release yet: region -> entry name -> the last released version when the entry was added (the `after` of a :::next-release marker). render-references.mjs wraps the entry's block in that marker; test/next-release-markers.test.ts fails once a newer version is released. Remove the entry in that release's site update, then run render-references.mjs. See website/CLAUDE.md, "Unreleased behaviour".
